subject: reasoning
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line facing the north(but not necessarily in the same order). G and C are sitting at the ends of the line not necessarily in the same order. F is sitting to the immediate right of G and the immediate left of D. E is sitting to the immediate right of D. A is sitting second to the right of E. B is sitting second to the left of C. Who is sitting between B and C?
solution:
Given:

Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line facing the north.

G and C are sitting at the ends of the line not necessarily in the same order.

F is sitting to the immediate right of G and the immediate left of D.

E is sitting to the immediate right of D. A is sitting second to the right of E. B is sitting second to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac03fd026f407c6ab31efc1c85c144aba0221a5d8728af61d39e5a2dba977498.png] 

Thus, A is sitting between B and C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
